integrity: Two independent finite implementations support the exact self-contained proof; no independent mathematical audit or external certification was performed.
scientific_limitations: Only smooth conic linear systems over F2 in the fixed coefficient space; the Frobenius-triangle construction and prior existence/maximal dimension results are already known. The inaccessible full text of Zanella (2012) creates a residual bibliographic priority risk for the incidence refinement.
title: The complete eight-vertex incidence geometry of smooth conic nets over \(\mathbf F_2\)
